verses.akrim-bi-ahmada-fi-nizami-l-mawlidi-c1-v: ʾakrim biʾaḥmada fī niẓāmi l-mawlidi ʾakrim bimawlidi ʾaḥmadi min mawlidi
qul lis-saʾūli fabidʿahu marḍiyyatu ʾaʿẓim bihā min bidʿahi lam tujḥadi
kathurat ʾasāṭīru ḍ-ḍalalati fī l-warā wad-dīnu maʿhūdu bimā lam yuḥmadi
wal-ḥaqqu ʿāriyatu biʾaydī ẓālimi wal-khayru sharru wadīʿati lil-muʿtadī
wal-ʿilmu ʾaḍḥā lil-hā kamusānidi wal-ʿadlu ʿidlu taḥta ʾamri l-ḥussadi
wal-mālu ṣurrifa fī l-ʿinādi waʾinnamā ḥaẓẓu l-ʾamīri l-fardi ḥaẓẓu l-mufsidi
lakinna mawlida ʾaḥmadi min shaʾanihi raddu l-makhāwifi kullihā ʿan mawridi
far-rūḥu tabtahiju btihājā bāhirā wan-nafsu tantaʿishu ntiʿāsha mukhalladi
wan-nūru fīhi muqassamu bijamīʿihi wal-yumnu baʿdu muyassaru lil-mujtadī
war-rushdu yarjiʿu lil-qulūbi mujaddadā war-rushdu khayru wasīlati limujaddidi
la khayra ʾila fī madāʾiḥi mādiḥi bil-khalqi wal-khuluqi l-karīmi muraddidi
ʾimmā bikāmilihi l-basīṭi muwaffirā ʾimmā bifaḍli ṭawīlihi lil-munshidi
ʾimmā bitazwīdi l-wufūdi bikhayrihi ʾimmā biʾikrāmi ḍ-ḍuyūfi l-wuffadi
ʾimmā bitaʿẓīmi l-ḥaqāʾiqi kullihā fī dhikrihi ʾimmā biḥḥubi muḥammadi
ṣallā ʿalayhi llāhu fī malakūtihi ʾawmulkihi salafā liyawmi l-mashhadi
hadhā jazāʾu l-muslimīna likawnihim yudʿawna ʾummaha khayri hādi murshidi
hadhā huwa l-qurʾānu yanṭiqu billadhī yuʿyī binūri hudāhu kulla mujalladi
hadhī ṣaḥāʾifuhu ʿalayhim ʾunzilat min rabbihim tasrī birūḥi taʿʿabudi
hadhī maṣāliḥuhum wakullu maṣāliḥi fī d-dīni wad-dunyā bishirʿahi muhtadi
far-rūḥu wal-khuluqu l-muṭaharu baʿdahā wal-māddatu s-suflā llatī lam tubʿadi
fahunā ḥaḍāratuhu ʿalayhim nuẓẓimat wahunā siyāsatuhu ʿalā l-mutaqayyidi
fabihā tuḥāsabu kullu nafsi ʾaslamat wabihā yuʾayyadu ʿahdu kulli muwaḥḥidi
mā lit-taʿʿasufi fīhimā min manhaji ʾinna t-taʿʿasufa sharru mā lil-mulḥidi
fakulū wala taṭghā waqūmū wāʿmalū bitafahumi bal fāʿbudū litazawwudi
ʾila famūtū bil-faḍīḥati wādkhulū nāra l-hawāni bikaffi mūri mūqidi
hadhā "ṣirāṭī mustaqīmā" ʾinnahu yahdī lʾaqwama bīsmi rabbi musʿidi
fabiʾafṣaḥi l-fuṣaḥāʾi yawma ḥiwārihim wabiʾansaki n-nussāki layla tahhajudi
wabikhayri man qad salla sayfā fī l-waghā raddā liṭughyāni l-kafūri l-ʾaṣyadi
wabiman yarāhu l-ʾanbiyāʾu ḥakīmahum war-ruslu sayyidahum waʾanqā s-sayyidi
wabiman ʾatā bil-ʿilmi muʿjizata lahu ʿilmā biʾanna l-ʿaṣra ʿaṣru tafaqqudi
wabihāshimiyyī l-ʾaṣli qabla maqāmihi khayri l-ʾamīri ʾamīrihim wal-ʾajwadi
bil-yusri la bil-ʿusri waʿdā ṣādiqā min rabbihi lil-muʾuminīna r-ruwwadi
war-raḥmatayni liwālidīnā kullihim wal-ʿafwa wal-ghufrāna yawma l-mawʿidi
ʾarjū qaḍāʾa ḥawāʾijī waḥawāʾiji l-ʾikhwāni fī dhā l-yawmi fī dhāka l-ghadi
